name: Eruption
description: Powerful explosion, black clouds of ash, rivers of searing lava, destroying everything in its path — this paint will make your tank a true disaster for your enemies.
interestingFacts: Paint was added to containers on May 18, 2018.

If you put a magic ring on your barrel while wearing this paint, it'll make your tank invisible. Unfortunately, you'll also melt the ring and destroy it forever, but I suppose it'll be fun while it lasts.
